name: v0.1.0-release-prep
goal: Archive all branches, clean up repo, rewrite git history with 6 logical milestone commits, tag v0.1.0, and set main to the rewritten history.

subtasks.name: archive-branches
subtasks.description: Archive all branches (main, openagentsctl, claude/review-opencode-config-QRFLS, simple-rewrite) to archive/* on origin

subtasks.name: repo-cleanup
subtasks.description: Rewrite .gitignore with lean project-specific rules; remove .opencode/session-ids/ and .opencode/inbox/ from git tracking

subtasks.name: update-user-docs
subtasks.description: Audit all user-facing docs (README.md, FEATURES.md, docs/CONCEPTS.md, docs/USAGE.md) against current implementation and update anything inaccurate or missing

subtasks.name: rewrite-history
subtasks.description: Create orphan branch with 6 logical milestone commits starting from b965159 tree

subtasks.name: finalize-release
subtasks.description: Set main to rewritten history, delete simple-rewrite, tag v0.1.0, push all to origin
